findings.rationale: Import deduplication still keys projects solely by name. A runtime check with north/demo and south/demo retained only south/demo, although sameProject now identifies them as distinct projects. Deduplicate by both organization and name to preserve both projects.

findings.quote: Wählen Sie einen Projektnamen, den noch keine andere Organisation verwendet.
findings.rationale: This current project-creation guidance requires a name unused by other organizations, contradicting organization-scoped identity. Update it to require uniqueness only within the project's organization.

limitations: The existing smoke test passes but covers only matching organization/name pairs; its assertion remains valid and is not a contradiction.
